curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Sort vehicles into Class D, E, F, G and M by weight rating, combination and wheels.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per class rule, with the weight and combination contrasts tightened.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items that name a vehicle and ask which class covers it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Introduce the three commercial classes and the one-license rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each commercial class and for what you must carry.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that separate Class A, B and C by combination, weight and use.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk a new applicant from documents to the permit's hours, supervisors and waiting period.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on permit age, hours, supervisors and the earliest license date.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on who may supervise and when a permit holder may drive.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast the adult and teen routes to a first license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the waiting period, driver education, school and the PDLA form.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that ask what a teen or adult applicant still needs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Lay out the graduated stages with their ages, hours and passenger limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each stage's age, driving hours, passengers and points.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Time-of-day and passenger scenarios for teen drivers.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the work and activity waiver and the two routes to full privileges.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on waiver limits, waiver paperwork and the sleeve.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on what a waiver allows and when full privileges begin.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain which tests each license needs and the rules of the knowledge test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on test requirements, test conduct and third-party testers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on which tests apply and what fails the knowledge test.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Prepare the vehicle, the paperwork and the tasks for the skills test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on required equipment, what to bring and the test tasks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on postponement, automatic failure and skills test tasks.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec01-m01..sec01-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
